meaning: 有在伦敦举办类似比赛的想法
usageNote: have the idea of doing sth 就是'萌生了做某事的念头'，比 want to 更强调那个灵光一闪的瞬间！

examples.en: He had the idea of starting a similar race in London after watching the Boston Marathon.
examples.zh: 他看完波士顿马拉松后，萌生了在伦敦举办类似比赛的想法。

examples.en: She had the idea of starting a similar race in London to raise money for charity.
examples.zh: 她有了在伦敦举办类似比赛来为慈善筹款的想法。
